corrections.non_circular_binding: Future record embeds only B. H and protected merge M remain external. Execution requires exact current main and checked-out HEAD M, exact ordered B,H parents, one-file regular addition, and independent record and human-text hashes.
corrections.authorization_schema: Strict versioned schema added with no additional fields, no placeholders, and a one-hour maximum active interval.
corrections.single_use: The exact infrastructure role is absent and its tagged create-role call is the first mutation. Existing role state fails closed and no automatic rerun follows consumption.
corrections.provider_receipts: Pinned AWS CLI 2.36.14 captures safe JSON responses and provider response metadata per operation without retaining credentials or request-signing lines.
corrections.postconditions: Every creation/configuration receives an immediate read-back and terminal verification rechecks roles, policies, both buckets, evidence emptiness, and the standard trail.
corrections.audit_replacement: CloudTrail Lake is removed from the executable plan. A standard single-region trail records management events and exact-prefix S3 object data events to a separate Object-Locked audit bucket with log-file validation and 2557-day COMPLIANCE default retention.
corrections.evidence_boundary: Infrastructure mode has no evidence PutObject, multipart, evidence-retention, legal-hold, writer-assumption, or verifier-assumption operation.

irreversible_consequences: Object Lock cannot be disabled after either bucket is created with Object Lock enabled.
Audit log versions protected by COMPLIANCE retention cannot be shortened or removed before their retention expires.
The tagged infrastructure role creation consumes the authorization even if a later step fails.
Partial infrastructure is preserved and requires separate human-authorized recovery.
The standard trail, audit bucket, retained audit objects, and requests can create continuing AWS costs.

The protected merge M and independent record/human-text hashes must be supplied to the executor while the authorization is active.
